verdict.rationale: Unity's in-editor AI Assistant (com.unity.ai.assistant, beta) is documented as able to "analyze performance" and take project actions from natural-language prompts. That is a first-party, in-product way to get AI-driven analysis of the user's own project, but the evidence is a single thin line and the tools are beta and metered by Unity Credits. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what insights or suggestions the Assistant produces from project or analytics data, coverage of data beyond performance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Use it to create assets, automate workflows, analyze performance, and perform project actions using natural-language prompts.
send a message to the Assistant, you spend Unity Credits from your organization's monthly allocation
